title: Automated AI-Assisted Smart Contract Security Review Report
description: Reference shape for a report produced by this Skill. This document is the authoritative reference for scripts/validate_report.py, scripts/score.py and scripts/render_report.py, but it is not executed by a JSON Schema library at runtime (scripts/validate_report.py is a hand-written, standard-library-only validator; see docs/decisiones.md D-021). Every field here describes machine-readable data. Visible report prose (executive summary, finding descriptions, recommendations) follows the user's language; this schema, its enum values and its field names are always in English.

generatedBy.description: This report's findings, descriptions and recommendations are AI-authored. Deterministic scripts (preprocess/score/validate/render) only transform, check and lay out that content; they never author a finding.

skillVersion.description: Version of the Skill package (SKILL.md) that produced this report.

analysisEngineVersion.description: Version of the analysis instructions/prompting used for the finding-authoring step (2.1).

scoreVersion.description: Version of the scoring formula in references/severity-and-score.md.

language.description: Language of the visible prose in this report (e.g. 'es', 'en', 'it'), for metadata/rendering purposes only. Does not change any enum value or field name.

compilerVersion.description: Resolved or user-declared compiler version/range for the analyzed source. 'unknown' if it could not be determined.

scriptsAvailable.description: Whether the deterministic scripts (preprocess.py/score.py/validate_report.py) were available and used in this runtime. When false, scoreStatus must be 'not_computed'.

inputHash.description: Carried over from preprocess.py's inputHash for the analyzed source set.

completeness.description: Whole-analysis status. 'partial' or 'failed' here requires at least one 'NOT_ASSESSED' entry in categoryCoverage (see rule R-05 below) so a partial analysis can never render as if it were complete.

reasons.description: Typed reasons, normally carried over from preprocess.py's completeness.reasons plus any reason the analysis step itself adds (e.g. protocol context the user did not supply in 'pro' mode).

categoryCoverage.description: Exactly one entry per SC01-SC10, in that order. This is the checklist coverage view; it is separate from 'findings' so that scoring and deduplication only ever operate on real detected items, never on placeholder rows.

status.description: DETECTED: at least one non-informational finding in this category. NOT_DETECTED: this category was assessed and no matching pattern was found within the analyzed scope - this is not a claim that no vulnerability exists. NOT_ASSESSED: this category could not be properly evaluated (missing dependency, unsupported language feature, insufficient protocol context, etc.).

note.description: Optional short, user-language explanation, mainly used for NOT_ASSESSED.

findings.description: Only real detected items (security findings and informational notices such as a prompt-injection attempt). Never a placeholder for 'nothing found' - that belongs in categoryCoverage.

limitations.description: Free-text, user-language list of what this review does not cover (off-chain logic, deployment configuration, key management, tokenomics, governance outside the analyzed code, oracle/bridge infrastructure, deployed contract state, third-party systems, etc.).

explanation.description: Fixed English sentence rendered by render_report.py; not authored per-report.

scopeNote.description: Fixed English sentence: 'according to the analyzed scope'.

message.description: Present when scoreStatus is 'not_computed'; fixed English sentence explaining why no score is available.

scoreStatus.description: Top-level mirror of riskIndicator.scoreStatus, kept for direct access per the original field list; both must always agree (rule R-08).

gasSuggestions.description: Optional, 'standard'/'pro' only (rule R-06). Qualitative gas-optimization notes; never an exact gas-unit estimate unless it was actually measured.

compilerCompatible.description: Whether this technique is compatible with the report's compilerVersion; null if not checked.

id.description: Derived deterministically from stableKey by score.py; not chosen by the AI.

stableKey.description: Recomputed by score.py from category + primary (first) location + signature. A finding's stableKey is never trusted from AI input; score.py always overwrites it (rule R-02).

signature.description: Short, kebab-case, machine-meaningful slug identifying the root cause (e.g. 'unprotected-admin-function'), authored by the analysis step. Used together with category and locations to compute stableKey; an empty string is allowed but weakens deduplication precision.

status.description: 'informational' is for non-vulnerability notices (e.g. a detected prompt-injection attempt) and must always carry severity INFORMATIONAL (rule R-07); it never affects the score.

locations.description: At least one location is required. locations[0] is the finding's PRIMARY location and is the only one that feeds score.py's stableKey computation (see severity-and-score.md, section 2); an empty array would make that key degenerate and let unrelated findings with the same category+signature collapse into one (see docs/decisiones.md, D-022).

evidence.description: At most 5 short lines, sufficient to justify the finding. Never a full reproduction of unrelated code.

patch.description: Structure only; scripts in this Skill never generate or validate the diff's correctness. Always null outside 'standard'/'pro' mode (rule R-06). render_report.py always appends a fixed disclaimer next to any non-null patch, regardless of this object's content.

mergedCount.description: Set by score.py: how many pre-deduplication findings were merged into this one root-cause entry.

businessRules: R-01: findings[] contains only real detected items; coverage/absence is expressed exclusively through categoryCoverage[].

R-02: score.py always recomputes id and stableKey from category + primary (first) location + signature; it never trusts these fields from AI input, so root-cause deduplication stays deterministic instead of depending on the analysis step behaving well.
R-03: categoryCoverage[] has exactly the 10 SC01-SC10 entries, no duplicates, no omissions.
R-04: if any non-informational finding references category X, categoryCoverage[X].status must be DETECTED.
R-05: if scope.completeness is 'partial' or 'failed', at least one categoryCoverage entry must be NOT_ASSESSED - a partial analysis must never render as if it were complete.
R-06: mode 'quick' forbids any non-null finding.patch and forbids any populated gasSuggestions; HTML rendering is only available for mode 'pro'.
R-07: status 'informational' implies severity INFORMATIONAL, and informational findings are excluded from scoring.

R-08: scoreStatus (top level) and riskIndicator.scoreStatus must be equal; scoreStatus 'computed' requires riskIndicator.score/band to be non-null and consistent with the band table in severity-and-score.md; 'not_computed' requires both to be null and riskIndicator.message to be present.
